name: smwmusic-front-mission-gun-hazard-nature
title: Front Mission: Gun Hazard - Nature
description:
The Controller's theme from Gun Hazard. Could fit a villain's theme or a cutscene before the final boss.

There is a define in the Nature.txt file which you will have to change if your AMK version is 1.0.8 or earlier.

Update (1/29/2025):
- Made 2 slight optimizations when the Im_not_using_109 define is 0
- Fixed a possibility of a note's pitch being too low (Found by Daizo)
